{{Quote|As the war wages on, the wounded need care. It's not enough to get them the medical attention they need, but they need to be protected as they heal or the effort is wasted... The ''Sanctuary III'' is one of these safe havens.|[[Fleet Commander/Legends|Fleet Commander]] [[Porpman]] addressing [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]]|<ref name="SWPM">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars Tactics|unit=''Sanctuary III'' Republic medical frigate}}</ref>}}
The '''''Sanctuary III''''' was a modified [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its role as an armed and [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] was instrumental in the effort to curb losses during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Just before the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ''Sanctuary III'' was one of several in a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of ''Pelta''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] sent from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to assist in the [[Transport/Legends|transportation]] of wounded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the Republic's [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] before the [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical station]] could be destroyed by the approaching [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].

==Description==
Built by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]],<ref name="TCWCG" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] ''Sanctuary III'' was a red, white, and yellow-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] marked with red stripes on its upper-starboard and lower-port auxiliary wings to uniquely identify it, unlike the more commonly symmetrical striped wings of other ''Pelta''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]].<ref name="SWPM" /> Proprietary to the Republic,<ref name="SWPM" /> the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was not available for sale to outside organizations.<ref name="TCWCG" />

[[File:Sanctuary_III_on_approach.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Sanctuary III'' docking at the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], protection as well as [[Medic/Legends|medical]] attention was required for wounded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as they healed. The ''Sanctuary III'' was well-suited to the task, as it was not only well [[Armor/Legends|armored]], but could also withstand a sudden ambush.<ref name="WizKids" /> Though not able to inflict a great amount of damage, the ''Sanctuary III''{{'s}} [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser batteries]] were capable of delivering more firepower than a normal ship of its size. Although maneuverability with its [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] was poor&mdash;despite its variable wing [[Maneuvering jet/Legends|auxiliary engines]]&mdash;the [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] was equipped to evade enemy attacks with a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] rated higher than others of its class and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that propelled it through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="TCWCG" /><ref name="WizKids" /> In addition, [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droids]] and [[Targeting computer/Legends|fire control]] systems helped effect repairs to battle damage in a [[Time/Legends|timely]] fashion, thus keeping the medical frigate operational and its [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] patients alive.<ref name="WizKids" />

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA11">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the ''Sanctuary III'' participated in a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of at least four ''Pelta''-class frigates sent from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to evacuate stabilized wounded clone patients from the Republic's [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical station]], the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]. This operation was time-sensitive due to the imminent arrival of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]]. Armed with two giant [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] capable of wiping out entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], the heavy [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]&mdash;under the command of the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;was on its way to destroy the medical [[Space station/Legends|station]] from which the ''Sanctuary III'' and its sister ships were evacuating the clones.<ref name="SOM" /><ref name="EGSOM">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The ''Sanctuary III'' completed its part of the mission and was gone from the facility before the arrival of the ''Malevolence'',<ref name="SOM" /> which was ultimately [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|destroyed]] by Republic forces.<ref name="DM">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Before its appearance in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," which aired on [[October 10]], [[2008]],<ref name="EGSOM" /> the ''Sanctuary III'' was previewed earlier in [[October]] 2008 as a miniature in the [[Clone Wars Tactics|''Clone Wars Tactics'' expansion]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' collection, which was later released on [[November 12]], 2008.<ref name="SWPM" />
